title: Literature & Literary Analysis: Consolidation
goal: Combine free indirect discourse, averted turning points, critical litotes, motif recurrence, and thematic culmination in literary analysis.
grammar: review of discurso indirecto libre, estar a punto de, no dejar de, volver a / sobre, and terminar por / de

items: I can produce and analyse free indirect discourse and averted turning points (estuvo a punto de) in narrative prose.
I can deliver measured literary judgements with no dejar de and trace motif recurrence with volver a / volver sobre.
I can contrast terminar por and terminar de when analysing plot culmination and understated endings.
